parameters.name: AbnormalLevel
parameters.description:
The risk level. Valid values:
- **high**: high risk.
- **medium**: medium risk.
- **low**: low risk.

parameters.name: AbnormalTag
parameters.description:
The risk type.
> You can call the [DescribeApisecRules](~~2859155~~) operation to query the supported risk types.

parameters.name: ApiFormat
parameters.description: The API operation associated with the risk.

parameters.name: ApiId
parameters.description: The ID of the API associated with the risk.

parameters.name: ApiTag
parameters.description:
The business purpose of the API.
> You can call the [DescribeApisecRules](~~2859155~~) operation to query the supported business purposes.

parameters.name: ClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.
> This parameter applies only to hybrid cloud scenarios. You can call the [DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~) operation to query hybrid cloud cluster information.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC). Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query instance ID of the WAF instance.

parameters.name: MatchedHost
parameters.description: The domain name or IP address to which the API operation belongs.

parameters.name: OrderKey
parameters.description:
The name of the field used for sorting. Valid values:
- **discoverTime**: the time when the risk was first detected. This is the default value.
- **abnormalLevel**: the risk level.
- **latestDiscoverTime**: the time when the risk was most recently detected.

parameters.name: OrderWay
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:
- **desc**: descending order. This is the default value.
- **asc**: ascending order.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description:
The source of the risk type. Valid values:
- **custom**: custom.
- **default**: built-in.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number to return in a paging query. Default value: **1**, which indicates the first page.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paging query. Default value: **10**, which indicates 10 entries per page.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC). Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: UserStatus
parameters.description:
The risk status. Valid values:
- **toBeConfirmed**: to be confirmed.
- **confirmed**: confirmed.
- **toBeFixed**: to be fixed.
- **fixed**: fixed (manually verified).
- **ignored**: ignored.
- **toBeVerified**: to be verified by the system.
- **notFixed**: not fixed after verification.
- **systemFixed**: fixed (verified by the system).
